facts.t: Every night on the phone she tells Guinevere "Good."
Her room at the Academy is nearly bare: a tin of oil, a jar of spare screws, two tactics books stacked square and her father's old toolbox. Guinevere has never been inside; Vexana always goes to her.
Her mother died of an illness before Vexana could remember her, so she grew up alone with her father.
As a child she lived with her father in a row of Shield houses in the shadow of the city wall.
As a child she learned to hand her father the right tool without being told which.
During a real Ender attack she slipped out of the shelter to find her father, because she only wanted to be with him.
When an Ender raised its claw at her in the street, her feet would not move.
A soldier carried her away over his shoulder while her father stood against the Ender, and she watched the smoke close over him.
After her father died she was sent to the Shield's home for soldiers' children with one bag.
She blames herself for his death: she did not stay back, he came back for her, and she thinks it should have been her.
After his death she kept every rule, and nobody at the home ever had to tell her anything twice.
She refused a friendly girl's ribbon, believing that people who stand near you die for you, so nobody should stand near her.
She trained alone at dawn with a wooden drill pole, telling herself she owed her father and would pay it back in Enders.
Lesley found her at the home and told her to come to the Academy's first intake.
When she first saw Guinevere at the Academy gate she thought of her as a lamp, someone so bright she had never been in the dark.
At the entrance assessment her needle passed the line, and she told Lesley she came "To destroy the Enders."
During a real siren in the shelter she sat alone on the bench by the door, hands flat on her knees, eyes on the door.
Through the preparatory year she trained every night in the training hall gallery without a sound, ate alone and answered in one word.
She wears white gloves; under them her palms are ridged and hard from the drill pole.
On the night Guinevere bled on the heavy bag, she came down from the gallery and left a roll of cloth tape on Guinevere's jacket.
On Team-Up Day she told Guinevere "You are strong, Guinevere," though she had never said her name aloud before.
She has black hair and violet eyes with a hard light far back in them.
She refused to be Guinevere's partner because she liked her and could not bear to watch someone die for her again.
In the raid at the dome's foot she followed Guinevere a street back, and her arrow came one breath too late to stop the claw.
After fighting back to back with Guinevere, she broke her own rule and decided: "I like her. That's why it has to be yes."
She follows a written plan exactly; when Guinevere says she can do more than fifty, she answers "It says fifty."
Whenever the training hall stays lit late, she phones Guinevere and tells her to go to bed.
She will not talk about who taught her to mend things or about her family.
In the team test, kneeling to mend her staff, she saw Guinevere standing where her father had stood, and made her hands keep working.
She had never spent any of her Academy stipend; it lay in the bottom tray of the toolbox, still in its paper bands.
She thinks of every gift as a debt, and fears owing Guinevere as she owes her father a life.
She returned all of Guinevere's gifts and told her "I am not something you buy."
Nobody had ever made her anything before Guinevere made the Emblems of Hope.
Each night she puts her star and the pink keychain in the white box, and each morning she puts them back on.
On the night of the fireworks she let herself smile without pressing it flat.
On the day of the tree she told Guinevere "My father liked the stars," the first time she spoke of him.
Before the day of the tree she had never seen her own face smile.
Afraid Guinevere would be first through any way into the void, she resolved to find it first, and read Chang'e's paper alone in the library.
She found Guinevere's lost drone in a gutter, mended it and set it on Guinevere's charger at night without being heard.
She knows Chang'e's paper by heart and believes two Aspirants would shine brighter than one.

After soldering the Emblems she had them on five fingers.
It hangs at the far end of the long hall.
The afternoon sun lights it for a while.
A lamp under it burns on into the night.

ties.t: It hangs in the long hall.

facts.t: It reads WITH THANKS TO THE PATRONS OF SELRICK ACADEMY and lists the families who gave money, with HOUSE BAROQUE first.
Under it two cadets once said Guinevere's score was bought.

ties.t: It hangs above the fountain.

facts.t: The final trial of the preparatory course never goes on the rankings board.
Guinevere slips a written plan under Vexana's door before the bells.
It is written in three colors: Guinevere's lines in pink, Vexana's in violet and the rest in gold.
It carries Guinevere's phone number, underlined twice, for emergencies or anything.
Guinevere writes extra so she will at least do half; Vexana does all of it.
On the day of the team test it said only "Team test. Win it. (I mean it.)"
After the quarrel a plan said "The roof. Noon. (Please.)"
Guinevere pays with a black card with a small gold House Baroque crest in its corner.
She turns it over at night and thinks her father paid for every gift she ever gave.
She stops before using it at the cake shop and offers to treat Vexana instead.

ties.t: It carries the House crest.

facts.t: A hair clip shaped like a star, which Guinevere held against Vexana's black hair.
Against Vexana's hair the little star looked lit.
Vexana returned it on its little card, holding it longer than the rest.
Vexana going still over it gave Guinevere the idea for stars.
At the fabric stall Vexana chose a square of felt the pink of Guinevere's hair.
She took a black square too, since the pink looked wrong on its own.
It was for someone else, so she did not count it as a debt, and kept it in her drawer.
She cut a small round head from the pink and another from the black, and began to sew.
A note in Vexana's small square letters, left on top of the returned gift bags.
Guinevere crumpled it in her fist.
The words come up in Vexana again at the keychain stall, and she does not say them.
Two five-pointed stars Guinevere cut from thin gold plate and soldered by hand.
Guinevere named them Emblems of Hope.
One is pinned to Vexana's collar and one to Guinevere's.
They need two people to light, so Guinevere could not test them alone.
Vexana's star has one seam a hair crooked; it was meant to be Guinevere's.
They glow soft gold when the partners' powers are in sync.
They beep when the two come back near each other after being apart.
They brighten when Vexana smiles.
When Vexana touches hers, both stars brighten.

ties.t: Guinevere made them.

facts.t: A white cake box tied with string, from the girls' house.
Vexana keeps the summer's keepsakes in it: the ticket stubs, the paper fan and the folded napkin.
Each night she puts her star and keychain in it, and each morning she puts them back on.
She never told Guinevere about it.
It sits on her desk holding everything she kept from the summer.
Guinevere handed Vexana the stub of each amusement park ride ticket without looking.
Vexana keeps them because nobody could call them debts.

ties.t: Kept in the white box.

facts.t: A paper fan painted with goldfish that Guinevere bought from a cart to fan Vexana, then gave her.

ties.t: Kept in the white box.

facts.t: The paper napkin from Guinevere's half doughnut, which Vexana folded small and kept, jam and all.

ties.t: Kept in the white box.

facts.t: Guinevere says nothing can resist one, not even robots.
She tore one in two and gave Vexana half.
Tiny big-headed doll keychains, one for every hair color.
Guinevere hangs a black-haired one on her own belt and gives Vexana a pink-haired one.
She says "Now you have me on yours."
Vexana keeps hers in the white box at night and wears it by day.
Small blue shields with the Academy's crest, given once a year to the best pair.
Guinevere held hers over her head all the way out of the hall.
She pinned hers back on crooked; Vexana's never came off.
Guinevere thumps hers when she vows to find a way.
It shows Guinevere and Vexana hand in hand with heads turned to each other, Vexana smiling.
The camera droid printed one copy each in a thin black frame.
Vexana made it her phone wallpaper.
Vexana stood it on her desk beside the white box.
It covered the courtyard wall: the two back to back, their names GUINEVERE and VEXANA in big letters and a line about their undefeated record.
Chang'e says the Will of the Planet can be defeated only by destroying it.
It is hidden in the Will's dark void.
Chang'e says it is whatever steers all the Enders; that is what the name means.
As proof something steers them, she shows every Ender signal stopping at once in a lull.
Guinevere vows to find a way to destroy it.
Smashing it is Guinevere's Plan A.

ties.t: It is hidden in the void.
It steers them all.

facts.t: When an Ender swings its chest opens, and Guinevere punches the core.
Vexana's violet arrow fell into an Ender's open core.

ties.t: It lies inside an Ender's chest.

facts.t: Outside the dome the Enders come out of portals; at their edge every reading drops to nothing.
Chang'e says their gate portal only joins one street to another.
It dropped Guinevere and Vexana at a cleared lot by the dome's foot.

things.name: On Aspirant Power and the Black Hole

facts.t: Chang'e mentions one idea in a paper on black holes but will not teach it, since it is untested.
Its heading reads: On Aspirant Power and the Black Hole. A theory of the void. Status: untested.
Most of it is readings and numbers; it says a black hole tears apart whatever falls in, the body first.
Its key line says an Aspirant's light would shine on inside a black hole and find its way home.
Vexana knows it by heart.
It reports a test in which a lit core sealed in an airless glass chamber kept its light.
It says would, not will.

ties.t: Chang'e wrote it.

facts.t: A suit of armor Selena raises from her desk screen; it has a visor and a weapon along one arm.
Selena says it is made of Ender plating, her own design.
Fanny thinks its joints would take a hit.
Selena says it comes in any size, for a price.
Guinevere thinks it is good and decides to find the fault later.

ties.t: Selena designed it.

facts.t: Selena draws armor in it during Chang'e's lesson.
Her pen keeps moving in it while Chang'e talks about the Mother Matrix.
A machine shaped like a silver dragon, with blue light along its seams and an empty seat on its back, that clicks at Selena's heel.
It is called Silverbolt, Selena's dragon-shaped machine.

ties.t: It follows at Selena's heel.

facts.t: Angela carries it in the crook of her arm.
Ruby holds it point-down on the floor in front of Lesley.
When she arrived she planted it on the dirt and bowed.
On the day the black ships landed, Guinevere and Vexana held the giants' front.
Days later a black ship settled at a cleared lot, and two girls came down its ramp.
The Support Division learns to mend Aspirants and their suits.
On the day the Academy opened, Guinevere saw a line of people flying over the hill on wings of light toward the water.
She says she wanted some, and now she has some.
Guinevere thinks Layla would rather stay in the VR than stand behind anybody.
Each week Guinevere mailed home every sum her House tutors set, with a letter headed Father.
In the first she added: I can hold two drones now. Nearly.
Under her last page of sums she asked her father to come and watch the final trial.
A week before the ceremony she wrote him one line, the day and what for, and no answer came.

ties.t: They are written to him.

facts.t: Vexana's father wore one; in the attack all she could see was his back in his Shield coat.
Vexana remembers his back in it between her and the raised claw.

ties.t: The coat of a Shield soldier.

facts.t: Guinevere came out of the third shop with a coat over her arm and put it in Vexana's hands.
Vexana's own coat was worn shiny at the cuffs, so Guinevere meant to replace it.
Vexana thinks a coat is a debt.
On the roof Guinevere admits the coat she picked was very ugly.

things.name: the attack on the wall houses

facts.t: One evening the bell rang while the tea was stewing, and every gun on the city wall began to fire at once.
Vexana's father carried her to the shelter himself, told her to stay back and ran to his gun.
The all-clear did not sound, and her father did not come.
Vexana slipped out of the shelter and ran through the smoke toward the wall stair.
An Ender that had come over the wall stepped out of a side lane a few steps from her.
Her father came down the stair and stood between her and the Ender.
A soldier carried Vexana away while her father stayed, and the smoke closed over him.
Behind them the wall guns kept firing, but her father's gun stayed quiet.
A soldier later said the Ender never got past her father while he stood.
Her father was recorded as killed in action.

ties.t: It struck the wall houses.

facts.t: On its morning Vexana walked across the city to it alone, her toolbox in a cloth bag.
About a hundred children queued the length of the Academy yard.
Each child put a hand in a glove wired to a dial that read aspirant power, and Chang'e read the needle.
Some children snatched their hands back at the hum, and one boy ran back toward the gate.
Layla's needle hit the stop.
A needle past the line sent a child through the far door to the Combat Division's preparatory course; the rest went left to the Support Division.
Lesley asked each passing child for a name and a reason for being there.

ties.t: It was the Academy's first entrance assessment.

things.name: the siren in the third week

facts.t: In the cadets' third week the sirens went for real, with Enders loose in a far ward.
The instructors herded the cadets into a concrete shelter, and nobody was to leave.
Everyone crowded the window slits except Vexana, who sat still on the bench by the door.
Vexana was the last one out at the all-clear.
It is the last trial of the preparatory course, scored by the instructors; it never goes on the rankings board and decides nothing but pride.
Guinevere wrote asking her father to come and watch.
The patrons had the front row, and the seat marked HOUSE BAROQUE stayed empty.
Steel dummies ran at the cadets on rails, one cadet at a time, while three instructors marked score sheets.
Guinevere got the top score.
Vexana ran it too, and saw Guinevere win.

things.name: the day at the office door

facts.t: On the rest day after the trial, Hester drove Guinevere home at first light.
Guinevere waited all day on the bench across from her father's half-open office door.
Morning passed; men with ledgers went in and out, and the door stayed as it was.
At dusk she held the paper up and said "Father. I took the top score."
He answered only "Stop being so stubborn and focus more on the family business!" and left.
Guinevere asked Hester to take her back to the Academy.
Guinevere later remembers sitting all day on the bench with the paper on her knee.

ties.t: It happened at the House.

facts.t: A banner over the courtyard read THE ASPIRANTS TEAM-UP DAY.
It is the day the preparatory course ends and cadets ask each other to be partners.
All morning nobody asked Guinevere.
Layla turned a boy away from the upper walk.
Vexana told Guinevere she was strong.
Vexana refused to be Guinevere's partner.

ties.t: It is held in the Academy courtyard.

things.name: the raid at the dome's foot

facts.t: On the third day after Team-Up Day a siren sent the reserve to the dome's foot, where Enders were climbing through a split in the dome.
The singles were sent to the side streets with the order that nobody goes alone.
Guinevere ran alone up the side street that led to the split.
A claw from a doorway raked her right arm.
Vexana, who had followed a street back, reached her and held out her hand.
They fought back to back until the street held.
The pairs came up from the main road after the last Ender lay still.

ties.t: It was fought at the dome's foot.

facts.t: Guinevere's plan for the day said "Team test. Win it. (I mean it.)"
A pair stood in a chalk square while steel dummies came down all six rails at once; a pair was out the moment a steel arm touched either.
In the fourth minute Vexana's staff split and went dark.
Guinevere held the front alone while Vexana mended it.
At the bell every dummy hung dead and both of them were still on their feet.
They won it.

ties.t: It was held on the training field.

facts.t: The day after the team test Guinevere took Vexana shopping because they had won.
Two House guards followed them.
Guinevere paid for everything with her black card.
Vexana secretly bought pink and black felt with her own stipend.
Before dawn Vexana left all the bags at Guinevere's door with a note.

ties.t: It took place in the arcade.

facts.t: Guinevere found the returned bags and the note at her door.
Vexana told her "I am not something you buy."
Guinevere took back the bags and shut her door all the way.
All the next day she loudly did not speak to Vexana.
On the roof Vexana admitted her word had been a lie in her mouth too.
Guinevere asked Vexana to the roof at noon in a one-line plan.
There she gave Vexana one of the two Emblems of Hope she had made.
The stars began to glow when the two made peace.
Guinevere took a photo of them both with the stars lit.
Guinevere said "We protect this world. The two of us." and Vexana answered "A promise."

ties.t: It happened on the dormitory roof.

facts.t: Guinevere took Vexana to the girls' house and ordered one of everything on the top row.
Vexana paid for the second pot of tea herself.
At the amusement park Hester followed them all afternoon with the cake box.
Guinevere bought matching doll keychains.
At the gate the box went to Vexana as a midnight snack.

things.name: the night of the summer fireworks

facts.t: At the Academy the fireworks start after the curfew bell.
Guinevere asked Vexana to watch them at the dome's edge.
They left by the kitchen yard gate after curfew.
Vexana gripped Guinevere's hand at the first rocket.
A shooting star fell, and Guinevere made a wish.
Vexana smiled, her star went bright, and Guinevere's flared to match.

ties.t: They watched from the dome's edge.

facts.t: The patrons had the front row, and the HOUSE BAROQUE chair was empty.
The Academy's first Best Aspirant Duo badges went to Guinevere and Vexana.
Lesley's whole speech was "Undefeated."
Guinevere shouted "We're the best partners in The Aspirants!"
The camera droid took the hand-in-hand picture they kept.

ties.t: It was held in the hall.

facts.t: Chang'e opened by asking who sends the Enders.
She taught the theory of the Will of the Planet, Balance, the Mother Matrix and the Control Core.
She explained the portals and the void.
She admitted nobody can get near the void.
She refused to explain her untested black hole idea.
She ended with "The Aspirant power is strong."

ties.t: It was taught in her classroom.

facts.t: On the day of the ceremony Guinevere lay with her head in Vexana's lap under a yellowing tree on the lawn.
Guinevere told the story of the wings of light.
Vexana spoke of her father for the first time.
Guinevere vowed to find a way to destroy the Control Core.
That evening Vexana went alone to the library and found Chang'e's paper.
Vexana calls it the day of the tree; by then it was last year.

ties.t: It happened on the lawn.

facts.t: Guinevere blamed a crosswind for her fall on a roof in it, but Vexana knew there was no wind on that roof.
One of Guinevere's drones was damaged in it, a cat ear bent flat and the bracket under it twisted.
On the night after it the drone lay open under Vexana's lamp, beside her phone.
Guinevere calls her fall that day a lady's refinement.
Weeks passed after it before the newcomers became Aspirants.

things.name: the day the black ships landed

facts.t: Guinevere and Vexana held the giants' front beside Lesley's squads until dark.

ties.t: The day the ships came.

things.name: the landing at the cleared lot

facts.t: Days after the black ships landed, the gate portal dropped Guinevere and Vexana at a cleared lot by the dome's foot, at the end of a line of soldiers.
A black ship settled on the dirt and two girls came down its ramp; the one with the scythe planted it and bowed.
The girl called herself an heir.

ties.t: It happened at the cleared lot.

things.name: the week the newcomers became Aspirants

facts.t: Newcomers became Aspirants in the Academy hall.
Ruby held her scythe point-down before Lesley.
Lesley gave a speech.
Layla answered Guinevere's wave with two fingers.

ties.t: It happened in the hall.

facts.t: Chang'e sealed a lit core in a glass chamber and pumped out the air; every needle on her dials fell to nothing, but the light held.

ties.with: On Aspirant Power and the Black Hole
ties.t: Her paper reports it.

facts.t: Guards shouted in the yard of the House; Guinevere ran out onto the terrace and saw people flying over the hill on wings of light toward the water.
She pointed with her arm straight up and said "That."

ties.t: It was the day the Academy opened.
